name: next-ai-drawio
description: Let the AI draw draw.io diagrams on a live browser canvas you can also edit by hand: create, edit and export .drawio/.png/.svg, with version history, undo and self-check screenshots. Wraps the upstream @next-ai-drawio/mcp-server (v0.4.15).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 让 AI 在浏览器实时画布上绘制 draw.io 图表，你也可以随时手动编辑：创建、编辑、导出 .drawio/.png/.svg，带版本历史、撤销与自查截图。封装上游 @next-ai-drawio/mcp-server（v0.4.15）。
